evidence.reason: Non-manifest dependency metadata (including binary bun.lockb) is now read as raw Bytes and compared byte-for-byte, while manifests are still decoded to UTF-8 for parsing, so lossy UTF-8 decoding can no longer make different lockfile bytes compare equal.
